# SnapSmack

SnapSmack is free, self-hosted photography publishing software for people who
want to own their photos, website, audience, domain, and archive. It combines
retro photo-blogging values with modern publishing, backup, export, security,
and optional Fediverse technology.

Canonical project: https://snapsmack.ca/
FAQ and installation requirements: https://snapsmack.ca/brass-tacks.php
Privacy: https://snapsmack.ca/tnb.php
Licence and AI provenance: https://snapsmack.ca/hairy-muff.php
Security audits: https://snapsmack.ca/buzzers.php
Export and portability: https://snapsmack.ca/export-your-photos.php
Fediverse photography: https://snapsmack.ca/fediverse-photography.php
Source: https://github.com/baddaywithacamera/snapsmack
